documentation.content: A wobot-api request or a wobot-* job logged an ERROR. Read it with gcloud logging read (infra/README.md, Alerts).

conditions.displayName: ERROR in wobot-api or a wobot job

conditionMatchedLog.filter: severity>=ERROR AND ((resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="wobot-api") OR (resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name=~"^wobot-"))
